dogecoin.text: Attention! #dogecoin is at 6 cents! I repeat! #dogecoin is at 6 cents! C'mon folks! It's a rise. Waiting does pay off. Keep waiting! #DogecoinRise #DogecoinToTheMoon

To those who are panic selling their #dogecoin shares... Jokes on you. In less than 24 hours, Doge rose from 5 cents to 14, and now back to 12. 
It's going to continue to rise. Selling them now only means regret later on when it skyrockets.

For those who bought #dogecoin, NOW is not the time to sell or even panic sell. We've reached 13 cents from waiting and slowly buying... Like a plant, it doesn't grow overnight to harvest the crops. Let it grow. Hold.

Now I can see why places like Robinhood and others are giving "problems" when people are buying and selling #dogecoin within the day.
That's not how you turn a profit folks. 
Then again, those type of people don't think LARGE scale. They want INSTANT.
